name: Avatar
summary: Passive circular identity thumbnail with explicit target-resolved native-image or initials composition and four fixed semantic size/type pairings.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive fixed-size circular container for one explicit identity composition.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored native image with context-appropriate alternative text.

anatomy.name: initials
anatomy.description: Optional target-provided one- or two-grapheme initials text used instead of an image.

sizes.name: sm
sizes.description: Small 32px avatar with Caption initials typography for dense supporting identity contexts.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default 40px avatar with Body Small initials typography for general identity contexts.

sizes.name: lg
sizes.description: Large 56px avatar with Body Default initials typography for emphasized identity contexts.

sizes.name: xl
sizes.description: Extra-large 80px avatar with Body Large initials typography for prominent identity contexts.

states.name: initials
states.description: Target-provided initials are the explicit rendered identity content.

states.name: withImage
states.description: A target-authored native image is the explicit rendered identity content.

behavior.name: passiveIdentity
behavior.description: Avatar has no intrinsic focus, activation, disabled state, status, keyboard model, announcement, or widget role; an actionable identity composes a canonical Link or Button outside it.

behavior.name: imageAlternative
behavior.description: Native image alt is non-empty when the image uniquely conveys identity and empty when adjacent visible text already names the same entity.

behavior.name: initialsAlternative
behavior.description: Standalone initials use one named image role with the full entity name; initials duplicated by adjacent visible identity text are hidden from assistive technology.

behavior.name: explicitComposition
behavior.description: The target explicitly authors either native image or pre-derived initials content. Image loading, failure, delay, responsive source selection, initials derivation, and automatic swapping are not neutral Avatar behavior.

behavior.name: fixedGeometry
behavior.description: The selected logical square does not flex-shrink; native image fills it with centered cover crop; invalid long initials are clipped rather than expanding layout.

behavior.name: semanticInitialsScale
behavior.description: Each accepted diameter maps to one existing semantic typography step: Caption, Body Small, Body Default, and Body Large. The mapping is part of size, not a second public property.

behavior.name: forcedColorBoundary
behavior.description: Forced colors retains a system-color circular boundary without opting out of the user palette.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Fixed semantic avatar diameter and its coupled initials typography step; Default is the classless 40px presentation.

accessibility: Use native img with contextual alt for image composition; do not add a second image role around it.
Give standalone initials one full identity name through aria-label or aria-labelledby; initials alone are not a sufficient accessible name.
Use empty alt or aria-hidden when adjacent visible text already identifies the same person or entity.
Keep Avatar passive and compose a canonical named Link or Button when the identity is actionable.
Do not use avatar color or an unlabeled badge as the only representation of status.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements fixed logical geometry, native image crop, and the accepted semantic initials scale; targets author identity content, contextual names, and image-or-initials fallback selection.

shopify.notes: Testimonials embeds the generated class around a Shopify image object and visible adjacent author name. Shopify remains responsible for choosing image or pre-derived initials; neutral Avatar owns no loading/error lifecycle.
